scope: Desk review of planar geometry and manufacturer drawings; not enclosure, mating-height, thermal, transient or hardware qualification.
plane_findings: 408 signal vias have a GND via or plated GND pad within 4 mm. Clock/write copper and via counts preserved.

Four remaining centre-line screening samples were inspected in independent Gerber enlargements. F_FAULT, F_WR_N and P_VSYS samples are at local via-clearance boundaries; radial ground resumes within 0.001–0.002 mm of the samples.

SD_DAT1 sample is in the small joined clearance between two SD_DAT1 vias. Ground surrounds the pair; this is a local antipad opening, not an unexplained board-length reference gap. No signal-integrity qualification is claimed.
assembly_findings: Fresh KiCad DRC has zero violations, including footprint courtyards. F.Fab/F.CrtYd/Edge.Cuts assembly drawing inspected.

SD mouth faces north with no component in its insertion corridor. Top mounting hole is west of the socket corridor. C19 is outside the socket courtyard; fit C19 and other low passives before the socket.
Pico module outline and all connector/mounting positions remain fixed. Check USB access and socket/header mating height on the first assembly.
J6 body and mate dimensions reviewed against manufacturer drawings; key faces south. Install tall headers after small SMD parts, verify cable continuity before motherboard connection.
J7 remains unpopulated for first assembly; keep D1 fitted. EFS adapter contact fit and enclosure clearance are later physical checks.
